description: Tournament founding and changes, replayed by reduceTournament (lib/protocol/tournament-state.ts).
format: Events are signed (BIP-340, zero aux randomness) with keys derived as sha256('blueline-vector:' + name). Expected outcomes are written by hand from docs/protocol.

cases.name: registration-waitlist
cases.description: Two places: the third registration goes to the waiting list and moves up when a player withdraws. Registering twice, and after registration closed, is refused.

cases.name: full-without-waitlist
cases.description: No waiting list: a registration beyond capacity is refused; manual admission keeps registrations waiting for the organizer.

cases.name: guests-and-claims
cases.description: The organizer adds a guest under an alias. A guest place is linked to a player only after that player claimed it; only the organizer adds guests.

cases.name: checkin-and-draw
cases.description: Check-in, then the draw opens the seed committed at the founding. The field is everyone admitted and checked in; a wrong seed, a wrong field and a second draw without a new commitment are refused.

cases.name: boards-and-results
cases.description: Boards submit results only for slots assigned to them; the organizer approves and corrects. A correction marks the next match built on it as affected.

cases.name: organizer-handover
cases.description: The organization changes only by offer and acceptance. Afterwards the former organizer's decisions are refused.

cases.name: rules-locked-and-unknown
cases.description: Rules cannot change once drawn, details can. A registration in a newer format version is kept, not executed.
